title: Comparative Planetary Magnetobiology of the Moon and Mars: Integrated Geophysical Mapping, Hypomagnetic Stress Synthesis, and Operational Life Support Frameworks for Deep-Space Exploration
description: Integrated dataset, analysis pipeline, and manuscript evaluating the magnetic environments across 36 prospective and historical landing sites on the Moon and Mars, synthesized with a systematic review of hypomagnetic field (HMF) biological sensitivity.
